title: Hydragen: High-Throughput LLM Inference with Shared Prefixes
technique: Exact attention decomposition into shared-prefix and unique-suffix parts; prefix attention batched across sequences (matrix-matrix products) to cut redundant KV reads; supports hierarchical (tree) sharing

optimized_metrics.evidence: In this paper, we investigate improving the throughput of batched text generation when the sequences in the batch share a common prefix.

headline_claim.text: Our method can improve end-to-end CodeLlama-13b throughput by up to 32x against competitive baselines, with speedup growing with the batch size and shared prefix length.

reported_metrics.where: Fig 3 (decoding throughput, tokens/s, vs batch size and prefix length)
Fig 5 (time to answer questions on 20K-token document), Fig 6 (total time for APPS evaluation)

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Left: End-to-end decoding throughput in tokens per second (TPS) with CodeLlama-13b when generating multiple completions from a prompt containing 2048 tokens.
metric_definitions.notes: Tokens/s over the whole 8-GPU tensor-parallel group (not normalized per GPU); generated tokens only (128 per completion); shared prompt prefill excluded or not specified. Offline fixed batch.

metric_definitions.definition_quote: Time to answer questions about a 19947 token-long document when benchmarking Yi-6B-200k on four A100-40GB GPUs. ... Time to process prefix is excluded.
metric_definitions.notes: Wall-clock for a batch of questions; shared-prefix prefill excluded.

load_regime: offline batch; fixed prefix length with batch-size sweep, and fixed batch with prefix-length sweep
tradeoff_acknowledged: Gains shrink for small batches, short prefixes, long suffixes, or GQA/MQA models where attention is not the bottleneck; proof-of-concept not a full serving system.
hardware: A100-40GB (8x for CodeLlama-13b TP; 4x for Yi-6B; single GPU microbenchmarks; L40S in appendix)
workloads: synthetic shared-prefix batch sampling, War-and-Peace long-doc QA, APPS competitive programming (120 problems x 128 candidates)
extractor_notes: Pure throughput paper; no latency/TTFT/TPOT/SLO. Baselines include 'No Attention' ceiling. Notably vLLM comparison was done with detokenization disabled variant too. Exactness (no accuracy change) is a property, not a measured metric.
load_class_quote: We benchmark end-to-end LLM throughput in the setting where many completions are sampled from a single prompt. (§4.1; batch-size and prefix-length sweeps)
